strategy.name: Qullamaggie Breakout
strategy.description: Momentum move followed by tight consolidation above EMA(20)/EMA(50), then breakout above the 20-period high with volume expansion. The ATR filter is the most important rule — skip every overextended entry.

indicators.ema_20: Short-term trend. Price must be above this during consolidation. Acts as dynamic support.
indicators.ema_50: Medium-term trend. EMA(20) must be above EMA(50) for bullish alignment.
indicators.atr_14: Volatility measure. Used to check if price is overextended above the breakout level. Most important filter.
indicators.volume: Breakout confirmation. Volume must expand significantly on the breakout bar (>1.5x 20-period average).
indicators.high_20: 20-period high (prior candles). This is the breakout level — entry triggers when price crosses above it.

bullish: EMA(20) is above EMA(50) — golden alignment

long: Price is above EMA(20) and EMA(20) is above EMA(50) — bullish trend alignment confirmed
Price is above the 20-period high — breakout triggered
Volume is greater than 1.5x the 20-period average volume — institutional participation on breakout
Price is not more than 1x ATR above the 20-period high — not overextended (most important rule)
short: Price is below EMA(20) and EMA(20) is below EMA(50) — bearish trend alignment confirmed
Price is below the 20-period low — breakdown triggered
Volume is greater than 1.5x the 20-period average volume — institutional selling on breakdown
Price is not more than 1x ATR below the 20-period low — not overextended

exit_rules: Stop loss: below EMA(20) or below the consolidation low (whichever is tighter)
Take partial profit (33-50%) at prior swing high or key resistance
Trail stop to breakeven after 1R is hit
Full exit if EMA(20) is lost on a closing basis
risk_rules: Risk maximum 1-2% of portfolio per trade
Maximum trade size capped by MAX_TRADE_SIZE_USD in .env
Maximum trades per day capped by MAX_TRADES_PER_DAY in .env
ATR filter is mandatory — do not enter if price is more than 1x ATR above the breakout level
Paper trade first — validate this strategy on your specific asset before going live
notes: Swing strategy — designed for 4H to Daily timeframes. Best applied after a prior momentum move followed by a tight VCP consolidation. Do not apply to 1m or scalping timeframes. The ATR filter is the most important rule.
